title: Watch: Introducing the L.B. Foster 320' Rail Consist
summary: L.B. Foster is redefining rail delivery with the successful development and first-ever delivery of 320-foot rail to Lake State Railway in Michigan.
body_markdown:
Transported using a five-car consist, this innovative rail solution eliminates the need for field welding while offering greater installation flexibility and significant cost savings. Unlike traditional 80' rail or continuous welded rail, the 320' can move in manifest freight traffic - delivering efficiency without the need for dedicated trains.


The 320' rail represents a smarter, more durable approach to modern rail construction. Learn how L.B. Foster continues to advance rail performance through innovation. Learn more:[https://lbfoster.com/rail.](https://lbfoster.com/rail.)
